title: Casita Cowboy: stylish, walkable Apt in East Nash
description:
Welcome to your charming oasis in the heart of East Nashville! This cozy 1-bedroom, 850sqft apartment has a separate entrance and parking and is located in a safe, walkable neighborhood steps away from coffee, dining, & bar spots. There's a spacious living room, small dining table, coffee bar with keurig coffee maker, desk area & washer/dryer. The bedroom has a large closet & TV. The kitchenette has a fridge, air fryer, microwave, & electric kettle. Step outside to a private shaded sitting area.

The space
You will have complete access to the downstairs apartment with your own entrance and outdoor area. This 850 sq ft apartment is one level and includes a large living room with TV, full bathroom with stand up shower, bedroom with large closet and a TV, kitchenette and coffee bar that includes a sink, mid size refrigerator and freezer, air fryer, microwave, coffee maker, electric kettle, dishes. A cafe table for eating and a full washer and dryer.

Guest access
You will have access to the back driveway where you will safely park away from the street. You will have your own entrance to the lower apartment including an outdoor area. 

You will not have access to the main house, backyard, front yard, front porch, stock tank pool, shed, garden or deck.
